name: Yokubou Yuusha ~Subete no Onna wa Ore no Mono~
original_name: 欲望勇者～全ての女は俺の者～
source:
The world is overrun with cute monsters.
A man with a love of the ladies sets off on adventure!
Knock down monmusu and administer H justice.
Help troubled village babes who repay you with H.
Get cozy with your party at the inn...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ163014.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 这个世界被可爱的怪物娘占据。一名好色的男人踏上冒险之旅！击倒魔物娘，施行H正义；帮助陷入困境的村中姑娘，她们会以性爱作为回报。到了旅店，再和队伍里的伙伴亲热一番……[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ163014.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
